# deezy

Global options go before the command, as in `deezy --log-level debug encode ddp movie.mkv`. Each command has its own page.

<!-- BEGIN generated by scripts/cli_docs.py: edit the parsers in deezy/cli, not this block -->

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
usage: DeeZy [-h] [--version] [--config CONFIG_FILE]
             [--log-level {critical,error,warning,info,debug}] [--log-to-file]
             [--no-progress-bars]
             {encode,find,info,measure,config,bitrates,tools,temp} ...

positional arguments:
  {encode,find,info,measure,config,bitrates,tools,temp}
    encode              Encode management
    find                Find management
    info                Info management
    measure             Measure loudness with DEE (1.0, 2.0, 5.1 and Atmos; 3
                        to 5 channels as 5.1)
    config              Configuration management
    bitrates            List the data rates each format and mode takes, and
                        the defaults
    tools               List the tools DeeZy finds, where they are and their
                        versions
    temp                Temporary folder management

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --config CONFIG_FILE  Path to configuration file (default: deezy-conf.toml
                        beside executable)
  --log-level {critical,error,warning,info,debug}
                        Sets the log level (defaults to INFO).
  --log-to-file         Write log to file (defaults to input path with suffix
                        of .log).
  --no-progress-bars    Disables progress bars on level INFO (disabled for
                        DEBUG or higher).
```

<!-- END generated -->

## Examples

- Encode a file to Dolby Digital Plus:

```bash
deezy encode ddp movie.mkv
```

- Use a config file other than the one DeeZy finds:

```bash
deezy --config my-conf.toml encode dd --bitrate 448 movie.mkv
```

- Log everything, without progress bars:

```bash
deezy --log-level debug --no-progress-bars encode ddp-atmos movie.mkv
```

- List the tools DeeZy finds:

```bash
deezy tools
```
